args.title: Triage issue 4403
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

src/export/csv.ts prefixes the CSV export with a byte order mark (BOM) by default (`bom = true`) to help spreadsheet applications detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly (commented as "Spreadsheet apps use the byte order mark to detect UTF-8 when a CSV is opened directly."). Meanwhile, src/ingest/parser.ts explicitly strips the BOM when parsing ingested statements (`if (text.startsWith(BOM)) text = text.slice(BOM.length);`). This is deliberate behavior and will stay, allowing options.bom to be configured or loaders (such as Python's `utf-8-sig`) to handle the BOM correctly.
